## Notes:

(1) Pay Range Increase: Employees at Min will automatically be moved to new Min.

(2) Pay Range Increase: Employees at Max will automatically be moved to new Max.

(3) Merit Increase calculated after Pay Range Increase.

(4) Employees at Max are not eligible for Merit Increases.

(5) Any employee with one year or more of seniority will automatically be moved to the minimum of $15,025 in April 2001.
